Description.value: Throw a slab of bloody bait and the thing hunting you breaks off to eat it - so you can run. Works on dire wolves and zombie bears too, though dead things never follow you home. Feed a living wolf or bear five times and it stops being a predator and starts being yours: it follows you, fights zombies for you, and never turns on a player. One companion out at a time, the rest wait in your kennel. Server-side, no client install.
